title: Last night of camp
style: cinematic horror film still, dramatic moody lighting with the subject clearly visible and centered, abandoned summer camp in deep winter, snow-buried log cabins, a frozen lake ringed by black pines, cold moonlight against warm firelight, adults only, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Final part. They waited all these winters for the caretaker. 🏕️

Original fiction. New series tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: every cabin at Pine Hollow lit up at ten, then went dark, until only Sam's window glowed, and someone knocked.
scenes.image: a single lit cabin window in a dark snowy camp at night

scenes.narration: He opened the door. Nobody. Just footprints in the snow, twelve sets, leading down to the lake. And the campfire, burning on the ice.
scenes.image: many sets of footprints in deep snow leading downhill toward a campfire on a frozen lake
a man in a heavy coat walking alone across moonlit lake ice toward a distant campfire

scenes.narration: They made room for him on the log. Moose handed him a tin cup of cocoa. It was warm. It was real.
scenes.image: a man's hands wrapped around a steaming tin cup beside a campfire on ice, blanketed figures around him

scenes.narration: Sunny told him about that summer. The storm. The night canoe trip the caretaker swore was safe. The lake that kept all twelve of them.
scenes.image: empty canoes drifting on a black stormy lake under lightning, pines bending in the wind

scenes.narration: We've waited all these winters, she said. For him to come back and finish the night with us.
scenes.image: a young woman in a wool blanket by a campfire, gentle and sad, firelight on her face

scenes.narration: Sam said: I'm not him. I'm just the caretaker. Moose laughed and held up the photo from the office.
scenes.image: a young man holding up an old faded photograph in the firelight

scenes.narration: Summer, 1981. The whole staff on the dock. And in the back, holding a ring of keys, the caretaker.
scenes.image: a faded 1980s photo of camp staff on a dock, a man holding a ring of keys in the back row

scenes.narration: Sam's face. Sam's scar on the chin. Sam's crooked smile. He had never seen that photo. But he remembered the day it was taken.
scenes.image: close-up of a man's stunned face in campfire light, a ring of keys hanging from his belt

scenes.narration: Lights out, Moose said softly. And under their feet, the ice began to sing. Tomorrow night, a new series: a mail carrier, a love letter, and a postmark from 1975.
scenes.image: a campfire on a frozen lake going dark, twelve figures and one man fading into blue moonlight
